status_note: The #48 gates rerun after the #46 read_body fix, with the #46 parity report. Every v1 to v4 case passes its gates and its parity row, and the Rust files the gates built equal the Rust files the parity run served (files_sha256).

supersedes.note: kept unchanged as the #48 record; it was recorded before #46 and has parity blocked

rust_changes_since_48: read_body refuses a JSON body that is not an object with 422 at body, as FastAPI does.
The v1 to v4 delete answers 204 with the application/json media type, as the Python product does.

target_contract.amendment: 1: timestamp column DEFAULT is CURRENT_TIMESTAMP for v3 and v4, now() for v5, as in the Python migration; independently reviewed and approved

gate.rule: bundle_checks, assemble_refusals and product_gates pass for every v1 to v4 acceptance case

assemble_refusal_notes: A6: the frozen base is example-v5, which is NOT_IMPLEMENTED (501) in #48, so the recipe uses the example-v1 bundle; the refused member and expected diagnostic are unchanged.
A9: the plan has 11 files, so README.md copies are appended until the DSL has 13 files.
A3: the v1 Python bundle with target rust is rehashed like the other recipes. It keeps the compiler-v1 order, which refuses the target member before any hash check.

target_checks.python_unchanged: Every source form without target, and with target python, equals the read-only reference compiler on 8765 byte for byte, and its bundle assembles to the same Python file bytes on both.

product_gate_details: The rustfmt, cargo and clippy commands run the toolchain.json binaries from its bin_dir after their sha256 checks; rustfmt runs with --config-path /dev/null, as in the service.
test_count: every test attribute in the product ran and passed, with none ignored or filtered.
divergences_d1_d5: each marker the prompt needs is a comment inside a test function, followed by an assertion or a refused() call, and the refused helper asserts.

fixed: The v2 schema step checks the prompt against som.compiler-prompt-family.v1 before the hashes.
INVALID_COMPOSITION names the first wrong block id; a missing block names the block list, a wrong or extra file names its path and a missing file names the file list.
The product gates run the pinned toolchain after sha256 checks.
Unrun parity is reported as blocked and the checker exits 2 instead of 0; with --parity it reads the #46 report and requires each case passed, strict-clean and with equal Rust files.
The test gate requires the full test count with nothing ignored; D markers must sit on checks.
Unknown --only ids are refused and the case set is checked against acceptance_total 115.
A3 is rehashed, and the A3 and A6 recipe notes are recorded here.
rustfmt is verified again whenever its size, modification time or inode changes.
